answer: One way to resist sybils is a non-transferable gas stipend: each identity gets a small daily allowance of task credits that cannot be moved between wallets. A zephyr of fake agents gains little, since a thousand clones only receive a thousand tiny stipends, while real work needs timber-solid history. Karst-like hidden cracks in the ledger get found by audits, and splitting funds costs attackers fees per wallet.
